name: phase-implementation-loop
description: Generalized phase-gated and autopilot workflows with shared orchestration, routing, and verification contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Run phase plans with gated or autopilot execution.
interface.longDescription: Reconcile markdown plans and Linear issues, assign separate orchestration and implementation roles across Codex, Cursor, and Claude, then use either per-phase approval gates or bounded autopilot execution with automatic green-phase commits and strict stop conditions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $phase-implementation-loop to execute this plan phase by phase.
